title: Cheap and easy to use.
text: Cheap and easy to use.. Works great, and like having all the various sizes all together.

product_metadata.title: Trudeau Measuring Spoon, Set of 5, Assorted
features: Imperial and metric measurements: 1/4 tsp, 1/2 tsp, 1 tsp, 1/2 tbsp and 1 tbsp / 1.25 ml, 2.5 ml, 5ml, 7.5 ml and 15 ml
Assorted colors: Grey, light grey, purple, mint and coral
description: Here is a Set of 5 Measuring Spoons as cute as it is useful. The 5 different spoons range from 1/4 tsp to 1 tbsp and can be used for dry or wet ingredients. They attach together with a removable snap for a compact storage and are made of BPA free plastic.
